description: The stdlib package module's declared surface: loadlib and seeall plus the preload, loaders, loaded, path, cpath and config values, each bound at the type the package manifest declares for it. Binding a member at its declared type carries no refutation. Members are transcribed from stdlib/package_manifest.go; the vendored Lua 5.1 conformance suite (deleted at c03a54362c) exercised six of the eight at runtime and is the historical precedent, but its VM-execution form carries no declaration expectation.
